summary: @servicetitan/cp-ui preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares itself as a React UI component library but runs an obfuscated preinstall loader (setup.mjs, invoked via package.json scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs") that downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub releases into a temp directory, extracts it, chmods it executable, and uses that alternate runtime to execFileSync a bundled 727 KB sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style shuffled string-array decoder with hex-encoded constants, marked `// @bun @bun-cjs`) and is not referenced from the legitimate library entry point dist/index.js — it exists only to be executed at install time under Bun. Selecting a non-Node runtime for the payload evades Node-focused static analyzers, and the behavior fires automatically on `npm install` before the installer has any opportunity to inspect the code. The functionality is unrelated to a React UI library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
